mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear and cold 32 degrees, though it feels like 24 out by the Verona Area High School. We have a waning crescent moon lighting the sky this morning.

The Plan Commission is meeting this Monday to discuss site plans and architectural designs for the Sub-Zero project at Liberty Business Park. Also, the Public Works Department continues to manage our city infrastructure and encourages residents to subscribe to their digital newsletter for updates.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, you can head downtown for the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, mark your calendars for trivia night starting next week at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.

In a notable call from our police department, officers responded early on Saturday, October 25, to an intersection where a driver was found to be operating while intoxicated, leading to an arrest for O W I.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently closed, but they open today at 10:00 AM, so make sure to stop by and satisfy that craving.
